intro.text: A scribe with the coalition's forces in Emul; competent, though rarely given important tasks.

items.text: Martra happened to be assigned to Dalinar the day he rode a highstorm in a vision to find out what was happening in Urithiru. She brought him a chair, was told to have his next meeting wait if he was late, and carefully recorded everything he said and did during the vision. After it, he told her to cancel his appointments for the day.
